findings.issue: VCG angle loss is nonzero for identical zero vectors and includes the zero-padded tail.
findings.required_fix: Mask degenerate VCG vectors and padded samples, guarantee zero loss for identical zeros, and retrain VCG-active cells.

findings.issue: MMD level 4 reuses the level-3 helper with different bandwidths for Kxx, Kyy, and Kxy, so it is not a valid shared-kernel MMD.
findings.required_fix: Mark level 4 inadmissible, use one detached bandwidth per fixed cluster for all kernel terms, and retrain level-4 cells.

findings.issue: Bipartite matching neither fixes coordinate units nor maximizes match cardinality before minimizing timing error.
findings.required_fix: Use consistent sample/time units and a maximum-cardinality, minimum-cost one-to-one matching or explicit FN/FP penalties.

findings.issue: Shapiro and Levene failures-to-reject are rendered as proof of normality and homoscedasticity.
findings.required_fix: Report rejected/not-rejected only and use residual or continuous variance diagnostics.

findings.issue: A fixed-QT algebra plot is presented as formula-stability evidence and uses overstated QTc recommendation/tachycardia labels.
findings.required_fix: Relabel as algebraic sensitivity, correct the clinical labels, or validate residual heart-rate dependence with QT-RR data.

findings.issue: The chapter claims EMG noise injection, but the executable suite implements only Gaussian noise and baseline wander.
findings.required_fix: Implement deterministic target-SNR EMG corruption and display it, or narrow the stated scope.
